title: Geopolitical Strategist: Bitcoin Is the “Third Way” Between the Dollar and Yuan
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Geopolitical Strategist: Bitcoin Is the “Third Way” Between the Dollar and Yuan Velina Tchakarova, geopolitical strategist and founder of FACE (For A Conscious Experience), argues that we're in a new Cold War and that the US and China are building two rival financial architectures. This post Geopolitical Strategist: Bitcoin Is the “Third Way” Between the Dollar and Yuan first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
